items.title: Glacier Bancorp: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Glacier Bancorp reported record quarterly net income of $105 million in Q3 2026, driven by higher yields on new loans and expanding profit margins. The bank's net interest margin surpassed 4% as $3.5 billion in maturing loans will reprice higher over the next year. Strong growth in noninterest-bearing deposits at a 15% annualized rate is lowering funding costs, while accumulating capital reserves are prompting management to evaluate share buybacks and special dividends.
